eligibility.notes: Per the process page, registration is by hotline or web form, staff then guide document preparation, and the contract is signed at a location. Whether a fully in-app application exists was not verified, so online is null.

textVi.value: Nếu quá hạn trả gốc, lãi trên số gốc quá hạn bằng 150% lãi suất trong hạn (tính theo năm), kể từ ngày quá hạn. Nếu chậm trả lãi, bị tính thêm lãi 10%/năm trên số lãi chậm. Các khoản khác trả chậm bị tính theo lãi suất cao nhất pháp luật cho phép. Ngoài ra, hợp đồng phạt 8% dư nợ gốc còn lại nếu bạn không báo thay đổi địa chỉ/liên lạc trong 05 ngày làm việc, và 8% giá trị nghĩa vụ vi phạm nếu cung cấp thông tin sai hoặc vi phạm khác. Lãi tính theo năm 365 ngày.
textVi.note: General loan terms (Điều kiện giao dịch chung, Điều 5, 15); the product-specific contract (Điều Kiện Riêng) is not published, so the in-term rate that the 150% multiplies is product-specific and unknown.

overduePrincipalRateMultiplier.note: "150% lãi suất cho vay trong hạn"; general terms, not the product-specific contract.

overdueInterestRatePercentYear.note: Interest on overdue interest 10%/year; general terms.

latePenalty.textEn: Overdue principal accrues interest at 150% of the in-term rate; 10%/year on overdue interest; contract penalty of 8% of remaining principal for not reporting an address/contact change within 5 working days.

values.value: 0.94%/tháng, tính theo dư nợ ban đầu (about 11.28%/year nominal)

conflicts.resolution: The page floor (about 11.28%/year nominal) falls inside the framework range, but the two quote different bases (flat monthly vs unstated yearly) and cannot be reconciled from published data. Both are stored with their kinds (advertised_floor and regulatory_ceiling); neither is used to compute a borrower's cost and the product is excluded from ranking.

values.note: Simulator on the loan list page offers 6-60 months (not product-specific; no stable URL captured).

conflicts.resolution: Stored 36 (the stricter maximum). Confidence lowered to medium.

values.value: Penalty of 8% of remaining principal for not reporting an address or contact change within 5 working days
Limits on penalties and fees in Circular 39 art. 13(4)

conflicts.resolution: The 8% penalty appears to differ from the limits in Circular 39 art. 13(4) and is recorded as published. Lawyer to confirm (lawyer question 6); do not present it as unlawful.

products.notes: Advertised rate is a floor quoted "từ X%/tháng (tính theo dư nợ ban đầu)"; the published rate framework (effective 01/03/2026, https://lottefinance.vn/images/resources/file/KhungLaiSuat_100226.jpg) gives 8%-66%/year (row 4) with basis unstated, so the rate a borrower gets is unknown. The calculator on the loan list page offers 6-60 months; product pages say 6-36; we store 36.

Ngoài ra, hợp đồng phạt 8% dư nợ gốc còn lại nếu bạn không báo thay đổi địa chỉ/liên lạc trong 05 ngày làm việc, và 8% giá trị nghĩa vụ vi phạm nếu cung cấp thông tin sai hoặc vi phạm khác. Lãi tính theo năm 365 ngày.

researchNotes: LICENSING: Lotte Finance is on data/licensed-institutions.json (id "lotte-finance", SBV finance-company list as of 2026-09-30). Legal name updated to the SBV list name on 2026-11-01: the company converted to a general finance company and amended its name on 28/8/2026; former name: Công ty Tài chính TNHH MTV Lotte Việt Nam. SOURCES: lottefinance.vn home and loan pages (static HTML), rate framework image "Khung lãi suất sản phẩm cho vay tiêu dùng" (effective 01/03/2026), early-repayment fee image (under Decision 26M135701/203 of 29/05/2026), general loan terms (https://lottefinance.vn/web/service/customer/termAndCond/loanTnC), borrower insurance page (https://lottefinance.vn/web/convenience/deptCancelSuspens). GAPS: (1) No minimum loan amount for any product. (2) No published representative example; the product list API (/api/loan/getLoanMainList) was not called. (3) Product-specific contract terms (Điều Kiện Riêng) with the actual in-term rate, fees and early-repayment rule are not published. (4) The rate framework gives %/year ranges per segment (salaried 8-66%, other-lender history 20-59%, life insurance 20-55%, women 20-66%) without flat/reducing basis; stored as regulatory_ceiling, so the true rate per product is unknown and all products are excluded from ranking. (5) Insurance premium and collection method not published. (6) Cash service fee amount not published. (7) Installment loans for goods appear only as rate framework section B (0-20% car, 0-30% medical, 0-66% other, 0-15% union-introduced employees); no consumer product page, no entry. (8) Credit cards (personal, Installment Card, L.Card) have fee/rate PDFs that could not be read; not captured. (9) Only four loan products are on the home page; other consumer products may exist (framework also lists state employee, retiree, business income, ride-hailing driver and good-Lotte-history segments). (10) App-based application not verified. CONFLICTS (see conflicts[]): terms 6-36 months on product pages vs 6-60 in the list-page calculator (36 stored); the product-page floors (0.94 / 1.98 / 2.03 / 1.04 %/month on initial balance, about 11.3 / 23.8 / 24.4 / 12.5 %/year nominal) and the framework minimums quote different bases and cannot be reconciled; for the women product the floor converts below the framework minimum of 20%/year. SURPRISING: early repayment is free for the salaried and other-lender-history segments (contracts from 12/08/2025) but 6% of early-repaid principal (minimum 1,600,000 VND) applies to other consumer loans; the life-insurance and women products are assigned to the 6% row by exclusion, so this is an inference. Overdue principal accrues at 150% of the in-term rate and 10%/year on overdue interest; an 8% contract penalty for not reporting address/contact changes within 5 working days appears to differ from Circular 39 art. 13(4) limits (lawyer question 6).
